{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders with non-missing revenue
df_completed_valid = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'].notna())]

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders with valid revenue
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed_valid['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue_completed"}
